_about: 撒豆成兵 · 守山门 (the defence crowd game) — the play, bundled by esbuild with Phaser marked external: the bundle loads the one shared Phaser (scripts/vendor/phaser.min.mjs) and the engine beside it (scripts/games/sadoushou/core.js). Dev build only: `npm ci && npm run build`. node_modules is never committed.
